<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en-US">
<head>
	<meta charset="UTF-8" />
	<script>
(function(){try{var t=localStorage.getItem('mariadb-theme');if(t==='dark'||t==='light'){document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme',t);}if(localStorage.getItem('mariadb-announcement-dismissed')){document.documentElement.classList.add('mariadb-announcement-hidden');}else if(!sessionStorage.getItem('mariadb-announcement-seen')){document.documentElement.classList.add('mariadb-announcement-intro');}}catch(e){}})();
</script>
<script>
/* Tap handlers that must work before the deferred, autoblocker-delayed scripts have loaded,
   delegated from here: the narrow-screen menu button, theme toggle, announcement close/reopen,
   homepage tabs, floating post ToC button and the collapsible sidebar boxes (blog categories,
   search types, Planet sources, page ToC). */
(function () {
  var root = document.documentElement;
  var boxes = '.mariadb-category-filter, .mariadb-search-filter, .mariadb-planet-sidebar, .mariadb-page-toc, .mariadb-downloads-sidebar-links';
  var controls = '.mariadb-header-menu-button, .mariadb-theme-toggle, .mariadb-announcement-close, .mariadb-announcement-reopen, .mariadb-home-tab, .mariadb-post-toc-toggle, .mariadb-filter-toggle';

  function store(key, value) {
    try {
      if (value === null) {
        localStorage.removeItem(key);
      } else {
        localStorage.setItem(key, value);
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  function toggleTheme() {
    var explicit = root.getAttribute('data-theme');
    var dark = explicit ? explicit === 'dark' : window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
    var next = dark ? 'light' : 'dark';
    root.setAttribute('data-theme', next);
    store('mariadb-theme', next);
    document.querySelectorAll('.mariadb-theme-toggle').forEach(function (toggle) {
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed', next === 'dark' ? 'true' : 'false');
    });
  }

  // Dismissal stores the announcement link, so a new announcement shows again (see js/announcement.js).
  function setAnnouncementHidden(hidden) {
    var bar = document.querySelector('.mariadb-announcement');
    var link = bar ? bar.querySelector('a') : null;
    root.classList.remove('mariadb-announcement-intro');
    root.classList.toggle('mariadb-announcement-hidden', hidden);
    store('mariadb-announcement-dismissed', hidden && bar ? (link ? link.getAttribute('href') : bar.textContent.trim()) : null);
  }

  function selectTab(tab) {
    var container = tab.closest('[data-mariadb-tabs]');
    if (!container) {
      return;
    }
    var target = tab.getAttribute('data-tab-target');
    // For containers whose panels are shown/hidden by CSS (only below a breakpoint).
    container.setAttribute('data-active-tab', target);
    container.querySelectorAll('.mariadb-home-tab').forEach(function (other) {
      other.classList.toggle('is-active', other === tab);
      other.setAttribute('aria-selected', other === tab ? 'true' : 'false');
    });
    container.querySelectorAll('.mariadb-home-tab-panel').forEach(function (panel) {
      panel.hidden = panel.getAttribute('data-tab-panel') !== target;
    });
  }

  // Core's menu script loads late: keep pressing its (hidden) open button until the menu is
  // open. The button is dimmed (.is-pending) while a tap is still waiting.
  function openMenu(button, triesLeft) {
    var overlay = document.querySelector('.mariadb-header-nav-row .wp-block-navigation__responsive-container');
    var coreOpen = document.querySelector('.mariadb-header-nav-row .wp-block-navigation__responsive-container-open');
    if (!overlay || !coreOpen || overlay.classList.contains('is-menu-open') || triesLeft <= 0) {
      button.classList.remove('is-pending');
      return;
    }
    button.classList.add('is-pending');
    coreOpen.click();
    setTimeout(function () {
      openMenu(button, triesLeft - 1);
    }, 150);
  }

  // Returns the control that was activated (so a duplicate event can be recognised), or null.
  function activate(target) {
    var menuButton = target.closest('.mariadb-header-menu-button');
    if (menuButton) {
      if (!menuButton.classList.contains('is-pending')) {
        openMenu(menuButton, 200);
      }
      return menuButton;
    }

    var themeToggle = target.closest('.mariadb-theme-toggle');
    if (themeToggle) {
      toggleTheme();
      return themeToggle;
    }

    var announcementButton = target.closest('.mariadb-announcement-close, .mariadb-announcement-reopen');
    if (announcementButton) {
      setAnnouncementHidden(announcementButton.classList.contains('mariadb-announcement-close'));
      return announcementButton;
    }

    var tab = target.closest('.mariadb-home-tab');
    if (tab) {
      selectTab(tab);
      return tab;
    }

    var postTocToggle = target.closest('.mariadb-post-toc-toggle');
    if (postTocToggle) {
      var panel = postTocToggle.parentElement.querySelector('.mariadb-post-toc-panel');
      if (panel) {
        panel.hidden = !panel.hidden;
        postTocToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', panel.hidden ? 'false' : 'true');
      }
      return postTocToggle;
    }

    var toggle = target.closest('.mariadb-filter-toggle');
    var box = toggle ? toggle.closest(boxes) : null;
    if (box) {
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', box.classList.toggle('is-open') ? 'true' : 'false');
      return toggle;
    }

    return null;
  }

  // iOS drops the click of a tap made while the page is still busy loading, but still delivers
  // the touch itself — so touches act on pointerup, and the click that normally follows is skipped.
  var lastTouched = null;
  var lastTouchTime = 0;

  document.addEventListener('pointerup', function (event) {
    if (event.pointerType === 'mouse' || !event.target.closest) {
      return;
    }
    lastTouched = activate(event.target);
    lastTouchTime = Date.now();
  });

  document.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
    if (!event.target.closest) {
      return;
    }

    var control = event.target.closest(controls);
    if (control) {
      if (control !== lastTouched || Date.now() - lastTouchTime > 1000) {
        activate(event.target);
      }
      lastTouched = null;
      return;
    }

    // Jumping to a heading from the stacked page ToC closes it again.
    var link = event.target.closest('.mariadb-page-toc a[href^="#"]');
    if (link) {
      var toc = link.closest('.mariadb-page-toc');
      var tocToggle = toc.querySelector('.mariadb-filter-toggle');
      toc.classList.remove('is-open');
      if (tocToggle) {
        tocToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      }
    }
  });
})();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>

	<meta charset="UTF-8" />
	<script>
(function(){try{var t=localStorage.getItem('mariadb-theme');if(t==='dark'||t==='light'){document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme',t);}if(localStorage.getItem('mariadb-announcement-dismissed')){document.documentElement.classList.add('mariadb-announcement-hidden');}else if(!sessionStorage.getItem('mariadb-announcement-seen')){document.documentElement.classList.add('mariadb-announcement-intro');}}catch(e){}})();

<script>
/* Tap handlers that must work before the deferred, autoblocker-delayed scripts have loaded,
   delegated from here: the narrow-screen menu button, theme toggle, announcement close/reopen,
   homepage tabs, floating post ToC button and the collapsible sidebar boxes (blog categories,
   search types, Planet sources, page ToC). */
(function () {
  var root = document.documentElement;
  var boxes = '.mariadb-category-filter, .mariadb-search-filter, .mariadb-planet-sidebar, .mariadb-page-toc, .mariadb-downloads-sidebar-links';
  var controls = '.mariadb-header-menu-button, .mariadb-theme-toggle, .mariadb-announcement-close, .mariadb-announcement-reopen, .mariadb-home-tab, .mariadb-post-toc-toggle, .mariadb-filter-toggle';

  function store(key, value) {
    try {
      if (value === null) {
        localStorage.removeItem(key);
      } else {
        localStorage.setItem(key, value);
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  function toggleTheme() {
    var explicit = root.getAttribute('data-theme');
    var dark = explicit ? explicit === 'dark' : window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
    var next = dark ? 'light' : 'dark';
    root.setAttribute('data-theme', next);
    store('mariadb-theme', next);
    document.querySelectorAll('.mariadb-theme-toggle').forEach(function (toggle) {
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed', next === 'dark' ? 'true' : 'false');
    });
  }

  // Dismissal stores the announcement link, so a new announcement shows again (see js/announcement.js).
  function setAnnouncementHidden(hidden) {
    var bar = document.querySelector('.mariadb-announcement');
    var link = bar ? bar.querySelector('a') : null;
    root.classList.remove('mariadb-announcement-intro');
    root.classList.toggle('mariadb-announcement-hidden', hidden);
    store('mariadb-announcement-dismissed', hidden && bar ? (link ? link.getAttribute('href') : bar.textContent.trim()) : null);
  }

  function selectTab(tab) {
    var container = tab.closest('[data-mariadb-tabs]');
    if (!container) {
      return;
    }
    var target = tab.getAttribute('data-tab-target');
    // For containers whose panels are shown/hidden by CSS (only below a breakpoint).
    container.setAttribute('data-active-tab', target);
    container.querySelectorAll('.mariadb-home-tab').forEach(function (other) {
      other.classList.toggle('is-active', other === tab);
      other.setAttribute('aria-selected', other === tab ? 'true' : 'false');
    });
    container.querySelectorAll('.mariadb-home-tab-panel').forEach(function (panel) {
      panel.hidden = panel.getAttribute('data-tab-panel') !== target;
    });
  }

  // Core's menu script loads late: keep pressing its (hidden) open button until the menu is
  // open. The button is dimmed (.is-pending) while a tap is still waiting.
  function openMenu(button, triesLeft) {
    var overlay = document.querySelector('.mariadb-header-nav-row .wp-block-navigation__responsive-container');
    var coreOpen = document.querySelector('.mariadb-header-nav-row .wp-block-navigation__responsive-container-open');
    if (!overlay || !coreOpen || overlay.classList.contains('is-menu-open') || triesLeft <= 0) {
      button.classList.remove('is-pending');
      return;
    }
    button.classList.add('is-pending');
    coreOpen.click();
    setTimeout(function () {
      openMenu(button, triesLeft - 1);
    }, 150);
  }

  // Returns the control that was activated (so a duplicate event can be recognised), or null.
  function activate(target) {
    var menuButton = target.closest('.mariadb-header-menu-button');
    if (menuButton) {
      if (!menuButton.classList.contains('is-pending')) {
        openMenu(menuButton, 200);
      }
      return menuButton;
    }

    var themeToggle = target.closest('.mariadb-theme-toggle');
    if (themeToggle) {
      toggleTheme();
      return themeToggle;
    }

    var announcementButton = target.closest('.mariadb-announcement-close, .mariadb-announcement-reopen');
    if (announcementButton) {
      setAnnouncementHidden(announcementButton.classList.contains('mariadb-announcement-close'));
      return announcementButton;
    }

    var tab = target.closest('.mariadb-home-tab');
    if (tab) {
      selectTab(tab);
      return tab;
    }

    var postTocToggle = target.closest('.mariadb-post-toc-toggle');
    if (postTocToggle) {
      var panel = postTocToggle.parentElement.querySelector('.mariadb-post-toc-panel');
      if (panel) {
        panel.hidden = !panel.hidden;
        postTocToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', panel.hidden ? 'false' : 'true');
      }
      return postTocToggle;
    }

    var toggle = target.closest('.mariadb-filter-toggle');
    var box = toggle ? toggle.closest(boxes) : null;
    if (box) {
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', box.classList.toggle('is-open') ? 'true' : 'false');
      return toggle;
    }

    return null;
  }

  // iOS drops the click of a tap made while the page is still busy loading, but still delivers
  // the touch itself — so touches act on pointerup, and the click that normally follows is skipped.
  var lastTouched = null;
  var lastTouchTime = 0;

  document.addEventListener('pointerup', function (event) {
    if (event.pointerType === 'mouse' || !event.target.closest) {
      return;
    }
    lastTouched = activate(event.target);
    lastTouchTime = Date.now();
  });

  document.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
    if (!event.target.closest) {
      return;
    }

    var control = event.target.closest(controls);
    if (control) {
      if (control !== lastTouched || Date.now() - lastTouchTime > 1000) {
        activate(event.target);
      }
      lastTouched = null;
      return;
    }

    // Jumping to a heading from the stacked page ToC closes it again.
    var link = event.target.closest('.mariadb-page-toc a[href^="#"]');
    if (link) {
      var toc = link.closest('.mariadb-page-toc');
      var tocToggle = toc.querySelector('.mariadb-filter-toggle');
      toc.classList.remove('is-open');
      if (tocToggle) {
        tocToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      }
    }
  });
})();
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en-US">
<head>
	<meta charset="UTF-8" />
	<script>
(function(){try{var t=localStorage.getItem('mariadb-theme');if(t==='dark'||t==='light'){document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme',t);}if(localStorage.getItem('mariadb-announcement-dismissed')){document.documentElement.classList.add('mariadb-announcement-hidden');}else if(!sessionStorage.getItem('mariadb-announcement-seen')){document.documentElement.classList.add('mariadb-announcement-intro');}}catch(e){}})();

<script>
/* Tap handlers that must work before the deferred, autoblocker-delayed scripts have loaded,
   delegated from here: the narrow-screen menu button, theme toggle, announcement close/reopen,
   homepage tabs, floating post ToC button and the collapsible sidebar boxes (blog categories,
   search types, Planet sources, page ToC). */
(function () {
  var root = document.documentElement;
  var boxes = '.mariadb-category-filter, .mariadb-search-filter, .mariadb-planet-sidebar, .mariadb-page-toc, .mariadb-downloads-sidebar-links';
  var controls = '.mariadb-header-menu-button, .mariadb-theme-toggle, .mariadb-announcement-close, .mariadb-announcement-reopen, .mariadb-home-tab, .mariadb-post-toc-toggle, .mariadb-filter-toggle';

  function store(key, value) {
    try {
      if (value === null) {
        localStorage.removeItem(key);
      } else {
        localStorage.setItem(key, value);
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  function toggleTheme() {
    var explicit = root.getAttribute('data-theme');
    var dark = explicit ? explicit === 'dark' : window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
    var next = dark ? 'light' : 'dark';
    root.setAttribute('data-theme', next);
    store('mariadb-theme', next);
    document.querySelectorAll('.mariadb-theme-toggle').forEach(function (toggle) {
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed', next === 'dark' ? 'true' : 'false');
    });
  }

  // Dismissal stores the announcement link, so a new announcement shows again (see js/announcement.js).
  function setAnnouncementHidden(hidden) {
    var bar = document.querySelector('.mariadb-announcement');
    var link = bar ? bar.querySelector('a') : null;
    root.classList.remove('mariadb-announcement-intro');
    root.classList.toggle('mariadb-announcement-hidden', hidden);
    store('mariadb-announcement-dismissed', hidden && bar ? (link ? link.getAttribute('href') : bar.textContent.trim()) : null);
  }

  function selectTab(tab) {
    var container = tab.closest('[data-mariadb-tabs]');
    if (!container) {
      return;
    }
    var target = tab.getAttribute('data-tab-target');
    // For containers whose panels are shown/hidden by CSS (only below a breakpoint).
    container.setAttribute('data-active-tab', target);
    container.querySelectorAll('.mariadb-home-tab').forEach(function (other) {
      other.classList.toggle('is-active', other === tab);
      other.setAttribute('aria-selected', other === tab ? 'true' : 'false');
    });
    container.querySelectorAll('.mariadb-home-tab-panel').forEach(function (panel) {
      panel.hidden = panel.getAttribute('data-tab-panel') !== target;
    });
  }

  // Core's menu script loads late: keep pressing its (hidden) open button until the menu is
  // open. The button is dimmed (.is-pending) while a tap is still waiting.
  function openMenu(button, triesLeft) {
    var overlay = document.querySelector('.mariadb-header-nav-row .wp-block-navigation__responsive-container');
    var coreOpen = document.querySelector('.mariadb-header-nav-row .wp-block-navigation__responsive-container-open');
    if (!overlay || !coreOpen || overlay.classList.contains('is-menu-open') || triesLeft <= 0) {
      button.classList.remove('is-pending');
      return;
    }
    button.classList.add('is-pending');
    coreOpen.click();
    setTimeout(function () {
      openMenu(button, triesLeft - 1);
    }, 150);
  }

  // Returns the control that was activated (so a duplicate event can be recognised), or null.
  function activate(target) {
    var menuButton = target.closest('.mariadb-header-menu-button');
    if (menuButton) {
      if (!menuButton.classList.contains('is-pending')) {
        openMenu(menuButton, 200);
      }
      return menuButton;
    }

    var themeToggle = target.closest('.mariadb-theme-toggle');
    if (themeToggle) {
      toggleTheme();
      return themeToggle;
    }

    var announcementButton = target.closest('.mariadb-announcement-close, .mariadb-announcement-reopen');
    if (announcementButton) {
      setAnnouncementHidden(announcementButton.classList.contains('mariadb-announcement-close'));
      return announcementButton;
    }

    var tab = target.closest('.mariadb-home-tab');
    if (tab) {
      selectTab(tab);
      return tab;
    }

    var postTocToggle = target.closest('.mariadb-post-toc-toggle');
    if (postTocToggle) {
      var panel = postTocToggle.parentElement.querySelector('.mariadb-post-toc-panel');
      if (panel) {
        panel.hidden = !panel.hidden;
        postTocToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', panel.hidden ? 'false' : 'true');
      }
      return postTocToggle;
    }

    var toggle = target.closest('.mariadb-filter-toggle');
    var box = toggle ? toggle.closest(boxes) : null;
    if (box) {
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', box.classList.toggle('is-open') ? 'true' : 'false');
      return toggle;
    }

    return null;
  }

  // iOS drops the click of a tap made while the page is still busy loading, but still delivers
  // the touch itself — so touches act on pointerup, and the click that normally follows is skipped.
  var lastTouched = null;
  var lastTouchTime = 0;

  document.addEventListener('pointerup', function (event) {
    if (event.pointerType === 'mouse' || !event.target.closest) {
      return;
    }
    lastTouched = activate(event.target);
    lastTouchTime = Date.now();
  });

  document.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
    if (!event.target.closest) {
      return;
    }

    var control = event.target.closest(controls);
    if (control) {
      if (control !== lastTouched || Date.now() - lastTouchTime > 1000) {
        activate(event.target);
      }
      lastTouched = null;
      return;
    }

    // Jumping to a heading from the stacked page ToC closes it again.
    var link = event.target.closest('.mariadb-page-toc a[href^="#"]');
    if (link) {
      var toc = link.closest('.mariadb-page-toc');
      var tocToggle = toc.querySelector('.mariadb-filter-toggle');
      toc.classList.remove('is-open');
      if (tocToggle) {
        tocToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      }
    }
  });
})();
</script>

<script>
/* Tap handlers that must work before the deferred, autoblocker-delayed scripts have loaded,
   delegated from here: the narrow-screen menu button, theme toggle, announcement close/reopen,
   homepage tabs, floating post ToC button and the collapsible sidebar boxes (blog categories,
   search types, Planet sources, page ToC). */
(function () {
  var root = document.documentElement;
  var boxes = '.mariadb-category-filter, .mariadb-search-filter, .mariadb-planet-sidebar, .mariadb-page-toc, .mariadb-downloads-sidebar-links';
  var controls = '.mariadb-header-menu-button, .mariadb-theme-toggle, .mariadb-announcement-close, .mariadb-announcement-reopen, .mariadb-home-tab, .mariadb-post-toc-toggle, .mariadb-filter-toggle';

  function store(key, value) {
    try {
      if (value === null) {
        localStorage.removeItem(key);
      } else {
        localStorage.setItem(key, value);
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  function toggleTheme() {
    var explicit = root.getAttribute('data-theme');
    var dark = explicit ? explicit === 'dark' : window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
    var next = dark ? 'light' : 'dark';
    root.setAttribute('data-theme', next);
    store('mariadb-theme', next);
    document.querySelectorAll('.mariadb-theme-toggle').forEach(function (toggle) {
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed', next === 'dark' ? 'true' : 'false');
    });
  }

  // Dismissal stores the announcement link, so a new announcement shows again (see js/announcement.js).
  function setAnnouncementHidden(hidden) {
    var bar = document.querySelector('.mariadb-announcement');
    var link = bar ? bar.querySelector('a') : null;
    root.classList.remove('mariadb-announcement-intro');
    root.classList.toggle('mariadb-announcement-hidden', hidden);
    store('mariadb-announcement-dismissed', hidden && bar ? (link ? link.getAttribute('href') : bar.textContent.trim()) : null);
  }

  function selectTab(tab) {
    var container = tab.closest('[data-mariadb-tabs]');
    if (!container) {
      return;
    }
    var target = tab.getAttribute('data-tab-target');
    // For containers whose panels are shown/hidden by CSS (only below a breakpoint).
    container.setAttribute('data-active-tab', target);
    container.querySelectorAll('.mariadb-home-tab').forEach(function (other) {
      other.classList.toggle('is-active', other === tab);
      other.setAttribute('aria-selected', other === tab ? 'true' : 'false');
    });
    container.querySelectorAll('.mariadb-home-tab-panel').forEach(function (panel) {
      panel.hidden = panel.getAttribute('data-tab-panel') !== target;
    });
  }

  // Core's menu script loads late: keep pressing its (hidden) open button until the menu is
  // open. The button is dimmed (.is-pending) while a tap is still waiting.
  function openMenu(button, triesLeft) {
    var overlay = document.querySelector('.mariadb-header-nav-row .wp-block-navigation__responsive-container');
    var coreOpen = document.querySelector('.mariadb-header-nav-row .wp-block-navigation__responsive-container-open');
    if (!overlay || !coreOpen || overlay.classList.contains('is-menu-open') || triesLeft <= 0) {
      button.classList.remove('is-pending');
      return;
    }
    button.classList.add('is-pending');
    coreOpen.click();
    setTimeout(function () {
      openMenu(button, triesLeft - 1);
    }, 150);
  }

  // Returns the control that was activated (so a duplicate event can be recognised), or null.
  function activate(target) {
    var menuButton = target.closest('.mariadb-header-menu-button');
    if (menuButton) {
      if (!menuButton.classList.contains('is-pending')) {
        openMenu(menuButton, 200);
      }
      return menuButton;
    }

    var themeToggle = target.closest('.mariadb-theme-toggle');
    if (themeToggle) {
      toggleTheme();
      return themeToggle;
    }

    var announcementButton = target.closest('.mariadb-announcement-close, .mariadb-announcement-reopen');
    if (announcementButton) {
      setAnnouncementHidden(announcementButton.classList.contains('mariadb-announcement-close'));
      return announcementButton;
    }

    var tab = target.closest('.mariadb-home-tab');
    if (tab) {
      selectTab(tab);
      return tab;
    }

    var postTocToggle = target.closest('.mariadb-post-toc-toggle');
    if (postTocToggle) {
      var panel = postTocToggle.parentElement.querySelector('.mariadb-post-toc-panel');
      if (panel) {
        panel.hidden = !panel.hidden;
        postTocToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', panel.hidden ? 'false' : 'true');
      }
      return postTocToggle;
    }

    var toggle = target.closest('.mariadb-filter-toggle');
    var box = toggle ? toggle.closest(boxes) : null;
    if (box) {
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', box.classList.toggle('is-open') ? 'true' : 'false');
      return toggle;
    }

    return null;
  }

  // iOS drops the click of a tap made while the page is still busy loading, but still delivers
  // the touch itself — so touches act on pointerup, and the click that normally follows is skipped.
  var lastTouched = null;
  var lastTouchTime = 0;

  document.addEventListener('pointerup', function (event) {
    if (event.pointerType === 'mouse' || !event.target.closest) {
      return;
    }
    lastTouched = activate(event.target);
    lastTouchTime = Date.now();
  });

  document.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
    if (!event.target.closest) {
      return;
    }

    var control = event.target.closest(controls);
    if (control) {
      if (control !== lastTouched || Date.now() - lastTouchTime > 1000) {
        activate(event.target);
      }
      lastTouched = null;
      return;
    }

    // Jumping to a heading from the stacked page ToC closes it again.
    var link = event.target.closest('.mariadb-page-toc a[href^="#"]');
    if (link) {
      var toc = link.closest('.mariadb-page-toc');
      var tocToggle = toc.querySelector('.mariadb-filter-toggle');
      toc.classList.remove('is-open');
      if (tocToggle) {
        tocToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      }
    }
  });
})();
</script>

<script>
/* Tap handlers that must work before the deferred, autoblocker-delayed scripts have loaded,
   delegated from here: the narrow-screen menu button, theme toggle, announcement close/reopen,
   homepage tabs, floating post ToC button and the collapsible sidebar boxes (blog categories,
   search types, Planet sources, page ToC). */
(function () {
  var root = document.documentElement;
  var boxes = '.mariadb-category-filter, .mariadb-search-filter, .mariadb-planet-sidebar, .mariadb-page-toc, .mariadb-downloads-sidebar-links';
  var controls = '.mariadb-header-menu-button, .mariadb-theme-toggle, .mariadb-announcement-close, .mariadb-announcement-reopen, .mariadb-home-tab, .mariadb-post-toc-toggle, .mariadb-filter-toggle';

  function store(key, value) {
    try {
      if (value === null) {
        localStorage.removeItem(key);
      } else {
        localStorage.setItem(key, value);
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  function toggleTheme() {
    var explicit = root.getAttribute('data-theme');
    var dark = explicit ? explicit === 'dark' : window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
    var next = dark ? 'light' : 'dark';
    root.setAttribute('data-theme', next);
    store('mariadb-theme', next);
    document.querySelectorAll('.mariadb-theme-toggle').forEach(function (toggle) {
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed', next === 'dark' ? 'true' : 'false');
    });
  }

  // Dismissal stores the announcement link, so a new announcement shows again (see js/announcement.js).
  function setAnnouncementHidden(hidden) {
    var bar = document.querySelector('.mariadb-announcement');
    var link = bar ? bar.querySelector('a') : null;
    root.classList.remove('mariadb-announcement-intro');
    root.classList.toggle('mariadb-announcement-hidden', hidden);
    store('mariadb-announcement-dismissed', hidden && bar ? (link ? link.getAttribute('href') : bar.textContent.trim()) : null);
  }

  function selectTab(tab) {
    var container = tab.closest('[data-mariadb-tabs]');
    if (!container) {
      return;
    }
    var target = tab.getAttribute('data-tab-target');
    // For containers whose panels are shown/hidden by CSS (only below a breakpoint).
    container.setAttribute('data-active-tab', target);
    container.querySelectorAll('.mariadb-home-tab').forEach(function (other) {
      other.classList.toggle('is-active', other === tab);
      other.setAttribute('aria-selected', other === tab ? 'true' : 'false');
    });
    container.querySelectorAll('.mariadb-home-tab-panel').forEach(function (panel) {
      panel.hidden = panel.getAttribute('data-tab-panel') !== target;
    });
  }

  // Core's menu script loads late: keep pressing its (hidden) open button until the menu is
  // open. The button is dimmed (.is-pending) while a tap is still waiting.
  function openMenu(button, triesLeft) {
    var overlay = document.querySelector('.mariadb-header-nav-row .wp-block-navigation__responsive-container');
    var coreOpen = document.querySelector('.mariadb-header-nav-row .wp-block-navigation__responsive-container-open');
    if (!overlay || !coreOpen || overlay.classList.contains('is-menu-open') || triesLeft <= 0) {
      button.classList.remove('is-pending');
      return;
    }
    button.classList.add('is-pending');
    coreOpen.click();
    setTimeout(function () {
      openMenu(button, triesLeft - 1);
    }, 150);
  }

  // Returns the control that was activated (so a duplicate event can be recognised), or null.
  function activate(target) {
    var menuButton = target.closest('.mariadb-header-menu-button');
    if (menuButton) {
      if (!menuButton.classList.contains('is-pending')) {
        openMenu(menuButton, 200);
      }
      return menuButton;
    }

    var themeToggle = target.closest('.mariadb-theme-toggle');
    if (themeToggle) {
      toggleTheme();
      return themeToggle;
    }

    var announcementButton = target.closest('.mariadb-announcement-close, .mariadb-announcement-reopen');
    if (announcementButton) {
      setAnnouncementHidden(announcementButton.classList.contains('mariadb-announcement-close'));
      return announcementButton;
    }

    var tab = target.closest('.mariadb-home-tab');
    if (tab) {
      selectTab(tab);
      return tab;
    }

    var postTocToggle = target.closest('.mariadb-post-toc-toggle');
    if (postTocToggle) {
      var panel = postTocToggle.parentElement.querySelector('.mariadb-post-toc-panel');
      if (panel) {
        panel.hidden = !panel.hidden;
        postTocToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', panel.hidden ? 'false' : 'true');
      }
      return postTocToggle;
    }

    var toggle = target.closest('.mariadb-filter-toggle');
    var box = toggle ? toggle.closest(boxes) : null;
    if (box) {
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', box.classList.toggle('is-open') ? 'true' : 'false');
      return toggle;
    }

    return null;
  }

  // iOS drops the click of a tap made while the page is still busy loading, but still delivers
  // the touch itself — so touches act on pointerup, and the click that normally follows is skipped.
  var lastTouched = null;
  var lastTouchTime = 0;

  document.addEventListener('pointerup', function (event) {
    if (event.pointerType === 'mouse' || !event.target.closest) {
      return;
    }
    lastTouched = activate(event.target);
    lastTouchTime = Date.now();
  });

  document.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
    if (!event.target.closest) {
      return;
    }

    var control = event.target.closest(controls);
    if (control) {
      if (control !== lastTouched || Date.now() - lastTouchTime > 1000) {
        activate(event.target);
      }
      lastTouched = null;
      return;
    }

    // Jumping to a heading from the stacked page ToC closes it again.
    var link = event.target.closest('.mariadb-page-toc a[href^="#"]');
    if (link) {
      var toc = link.closest('.mariadb-page-toc');
      var tocToggle = toc.querySelector('.mariadb-filter-toggle');
      toc.classList.remove('is-open');
      if (tocToggle) {
        tocToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      }
    }
  });
})();
</script>
